version: v1.6.2 — Smooth 60 FPS + Frame Limiter & VSync Fix
name: Geoplanetical Fire Performance Mod
description:
Made this mod for my laptop (8GB RAM / integrated graphics) to get smooth 60 FPS, fast loading, and smooth ticks without conflicts — works great on all PCs!

WHAT IT DOES:
- FPS Boost (clean lightweight dual globe shaders, no clouds/shadows, removes UI blur)
- Fast New Game (auto-bypasses 25s intro narrator stall + non-blocking atlas labels)
- Zero Simulation Conflicts (preserves official v1.1.2 engine, banking, puppets & trade)
- Zero RAM Thrashing (preserves native heap limits, prevents Windows disk swapping)
- Hotkeys: F10 toggles Fire Graphics with on-screen toast (F11 untouched)

EASY 1-CLICK INSTALL (NO NODE.JS NEEDED):
Steam Workshop only loads textures by default. Run installer once (uses game's built-in engine):
1. In Steam, right-click Geoplanetical > Manage > Browse local files.
2. Click 'steamapps' in address bar, then go to: workshop/content/4137120/3834097787
3. Double-click Install-Mod.bat and wait ~2s until it says Done.
4. Launch the game! You will see 'FIRE [F10]' and FPS in top-right corner.

HOW TO TOGGLE OR UNINSTALL:
- F10: toggle Fire Graphics ON/OFF with on-screen toast.
- Turn off in Mods menu, or run Uninstall-Mod.bat to restore clean game files.

OUR JOURNEY & CHANGELOG:
[v1.6.2 — Frame Limiter, VSync & Smooth UI]
- Restored FPS limiters & VSync (fixes 1000 FPS jump on Nvidia/AMD dedicated GPUs)
- Eliminated UI navigation stutter by freeing JS event loop from 1000Hz render loops
- Respects in-game FPS Cap settings (30/60/120/144/Unlimited) & driver rate limits

[v1.6.1 — Game v1.1.2 Compatibility]
- Updated renderer hooks for v1.1.2 hotfix (performance preset & settled idle gate)
- Adapts cleanly to v1.1.2's clean reload save-switching while keeping v1.1.0 support

[v1.6.0 — Clean v1.1.0+ Conflict-Free]
- Fixed Workshop .bat on (x86) paths (0.2s, no Node.js needed)
- Eliminated worker monkey-patches to prevent trade/banking/puppet conflicts

[v1.0.0 - v1.5.2]
- Flat globe shader, 2K canvas, blur removal, toasts & live F10 toggle
